beef.notes: Raw beef pieces or cuts clearly visible in frame.

butter.notes: Butter block or pat when visually identifiable.

carrot.notes: Whole, cut, or shredded carrot when visually identifiable.

chicken.notes: Raw chicken pieces or whole cuts clearly visible in frame.

egg.notes: Whole egg, shell-on or shell-off, if visually distinct.

garlic.notes: Whole cloves or clearly identifiable garlic pieces.

lemon.notes: Whole lemons or clearly identifiable lemon pieces.

milk_carton.notes: Carton-based milk container when the container itself is visible.

onion.notes: Yellow, red, or white onion when visually identifiable.

potato.notes: Whole or cut potato when visually identifiable.

tomato.notes: Raw tomato or clearly identifiable tomato pieces.
